Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D RPG pixel-art walking sprite atlas on a truly transparent background. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the reference's tiny old-school browser MMORPG character proportions, elevated three-quarter RPG viewpoint, sharp dark one-pixel outlines, compact bodies, detailed clustered highlights and clear separation between pixels. Generate an ORIGINAL character, no copying of the reference knight design. Do not enlarge the character into concept art. Do not produce any text, labels, titles, grid lines, border, floor, cast shadow, checkerboard or backdrop.
EXACT OUTPUT LAYOUT: a 4-column by 4-row atlas with 16 evenly spaced sprite cells, no gutters or margins between cells. Canvas should be 1024x1536 pixels, equivalent to a native 128x192 pixel-art sheet enlarged precisely 8x with nearest-neighbor. Each cell is 256x384 (native32x48). Every sprite must be full-body, centered horizontally, its feet on an identical baseline close to the bottom of its cell, with transparent padding around it; no sprite may cross cell boundaries. Keep identical character scale, costume, face and equipment across all16cells.
Rows top to bottom: 1 facing SOUTH toward viewer, 2 facing WEST left, 3 facing EAST right, 4 facing NORTH away from viewer. Columns left to right: neutral idle pose, walking left foot forward, neutral idle pose, walking right foot forward. Each row is a subtle readable 4-frame walk cycle with alternating legs and arms, not four unrelated poses. No weapons, shields, helmets or accessories outside the silhouette. Use a limited crisp pixel palette, hard square pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, no blurred edges, no painterly rendering, no photographic detail. The face remains visible from the front and both sides.
CHARACTER FOR THIS ATLAS: adult male; basic traveler: short brown hair, plain blue tunic, brown belt, dark trousers and brown boots.

alignmentEdits.prompt: Edit target: the attached character sprite sheet. FIX THE ATLAS LAYOUT ONLY while preserving the exact same female character, pixel-art style, costume, face, colors and four directions. Keep a 1024x1536 transparent PNG with EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal 256x384 cells. The current sprites spill across row boundaries; REMOVE THIS PROBLEM. Independently place each existing whole character inside its own cell, making all characters the same scale with their full body between y=40 and y=350 relative to its cell. Scale each character slightly smaller to fit, if needed. Feet baseline must be y=350 in EVERY cell and EVERY row. Leave at least 24 fully transparent pixels at the top and bottom of every cell, and 16 transparent pixels at both sides. No character pixel may be present on any cell boundary. Preserve row order SOUTH(front), WEST(left), EAST(right), NORTH(back) and columns neutral,left-step,neutral,right-step. Each cell must contain only its one complete intended sprite, with no fragments from adjacent cells. No extra sprites, no labels, no grid lines, no floor, no cast shadow, no background color. Actual alpha transparency outside characters. Do not add or remove clothing or change identity.

frameMetadata: Generated row spacing is described by rowBounds in apps/client/src/characters/characterSkinAssets.ts. Renderers crop complete source rows and align their feet in virtual 256x384 frames without editing the source art.
